title: Prepaid recharges and Data Bank
text: Tallowood prepaid recharges last 28 days. The $30 recharge includes 20 GB, the $40 recharge includes 45 GB and the $50 recharge includes 80 GB. All three include unlimited standard national calls and texts, and 5G access where available. Data Bank: unused data at the end of a recharge period moves into your Data Bank automatically. The bank limit is 100 GB on the $30 and $40 recharges and 200 GB on the $50 recharge. Banked data is used only after the current recharge's data runs out, oldest banked data first. Each banked amount expires 56 days after it was banked, even if you keep recharging on time. The app shows the expiry date of each banked amount. If your recharge expires before you recharge again, your entire Data Bank is cleared straight away, so turn on auto-recharge to avoid this. Extra data: a 5 GB add-on costs $10 and lasts until your recharge expires. Long-expiry option: the $300 recharge lasts 365 days and includes 300 GB, but it has no Data Bank. Prepaid credit: dollar credit added through vouchers or gift cards is used for international calls, premium numbers and add-ons, and it expires 365 days after it was added.

title: Postpaid mobile plans
text: Tallowood postpaid mobile plans are month to month, with no lock-in contract. Small costs $45 per month with 40 GB of data. Medium costs $55 per month with 100 GB. Large costs $65 per month with 180 GB, and adds unlimited standard calls to 20 international destinations. All plans include unlimited standard national calls and texts, 5G access, and Wi-Fi calling on compatible phones. Once your monthly allowance is used, there are no excess data charges; speeds are capped at 1.5 Mbps on Small and Medium and 5 Mbps on Large until your next bill period. A 10 GB data add-on costs $10. Multi-service discount: each additional postpaid mobile service on the same account gets 10% off its plan fee, for up to 5 services. Plan fees are charged monthly in advance, and usage outside your plan, such as premium texts, is billed in arrears. International roaming is switched on by default for postpaid services, and a Travel Pass starts automatically when you use your phone overseas; you can turn roaming off in the app. Changing plans: moving up applies straight away with a pro-rated charge, and moving down applies from your next bill period. Cancelling a postpaid service requires notice; see our cancellation terms.

title: Travel Pass, Zone 1 countries
text: Travel Pass for Zone 1 countries. Zone 1 covers New Zealand, the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Singapore, Japan, France, Germany, Italy and Spain. A Zone 1 Travel Pass costs $5 per day. Each day includes 2 GB data, unlimited standard calls to Australian numbers and to numbers in the country you're visiting, unlimited texts, and free incoming calls. For postpaid customers, roaming is on by default and the Travel Pass starts automatically the first time you make a call, send a text or use data in a Zone 1 country on a given day. Receiving a text does not start a pass, and days with no use cost nothing. A Travel Pass day runs from midnight to midnight Sydney time, not 24 hours from when it starts, so a pass that starts late in the Sydney day ends at the next midnight Sydney time. If you use more than 2 GB in a day, data slows to 256 kbps until the next Sydney midnight. Prepaid customers have roaming off by default and must buy Travel Pass days in the app before or during travel. To avoid any charges, switch off data roaming and mobile calls in your phone's settings, or turn off roaming in the app.

title: Travel Pass, Zone 2 countries
text: Travel Pass for Zone 2 countries. Zone 2 covers Indonesia (including Bali), Thailand, Vietnam, Malaysia, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, the United Arab Emirates, South Africa, Fiji and Mexico. A Zone 2 Travel Pass costs $10 per day. Each day includes 1 GB data, unlimited standard calls to Australian numbers, unlimited texts, and free incoming calls. Calls to local numbers in the country you're visiting are not included and cost $1 per minute. For postpaid customers, roaming is on by default and the Travel Pass starts automatically the first time you make a call, send a text or use data in a Zone 2 country on a given day. Receiving a text does not start a pass, and days with no use cost nothing. A Travel Pass day runs from midnight to midnight Sydney time, not 24 hours from when it starts, so a pass that starts late in the Sydney day ends at the next midnight Sydney time. If you use more than 1 GB in a day, data slows to 256 kbps until the next Sydney midnight. Countries outside Zone 1 and Zone 2, and cruise ships, are charged pay-as-you-go at $3 per MB, with calls at $2.50 per minute. Prepaid customers must buy Travel Pass days in the app.

title: Bringing your number to Tallowood
text: Bringing your mobile number to Tallowood. You can port a number from any Australian provider. When you sign up online or in store, choose Keep my number and give us your current provider's account number for a postpaid service, or your date of birth for a prepaid service. We send a verification code to the number to confirm you hold it. Most ports complete within 3 hours if requested between 8 am and 7 pm Sydney time on a business day; requests made outside those hours are processed from 8 am the next business day. Your old service is cancelled automatically by your old provider when the port completes, so don't cancel it yourself first, or the number may be lost. Your Tallowood SIM or eSIM will show No Service until the port finishes; restart the phone once you receive our confirmation text. Unused prepaid credit with your old provider does not transfer. Porting away from Tallowood: there is no porting fee. Give your new provider your Tallowood account number, found in the app. For postpaid mobile services, our 30-day cancellation notice still applies when you port away, and phone repayments continue as normal.

title: SIM replacement and eSIM transfers
text: SIM and eSIM help. Replacement physical SIM: free at any Tallowood store, or $10 if we post it to you; posted SIMs arrive in 2 to 5 business days. eSIM: new eSIMs are activated by scanning a QR code or directly in the Tallowood app. eSIM transfers to a new phone are free in the app, up to 3 transfers per calendar month. For a fourth or later transfer in the same calendar month, visit a store with photo ID, where the transfer is also free. When you transfer, the eSIM on your old phone stops working as soon as it is activated on the new one, so keep the old phone handy until the new one shows signal. Swapping between a physical SIM and an eSIM counts as one transfer. Security checks: before any SIM swap or eSIM transfer, we send a one-time code to your account email and your current number. If you've lost your phone, a store can verify you with photo ID instead. If your phone is lost or stolen, suspend the service in the app or by calling us, and we can block the handset's IMEI so it can't be used on Australian networks.

title: ID verification for new services
text: Identity checks for new Tallowood services. Every new prepaid and postpaid service must be identity verified before it is activated. Australian residents can verify online with a driver licence, Australian passport, Medicare card or ImmiCard, and most checks are instant. Visitors and visa holders, including international students: use your foreign passport plus your visa grant number, and give an Australian residential or accommodation address. The online check takes about 10 minutes. If it fails, visit a store with your passport and we will verify you in person. Postpaid services for visa holders need at least 6 months left on the visa and a successful credit check; prepaid has no minimum visa period. You must be 16 or older to activate a prepaid service in your own name, and 18 or older for postpaid. We do not keep a copy of your documents; we record only that verification succeeded and the document type used. Each person can verify up to 5 prepaid services online; more than that needs a store visit.

title: Home internet plans
text: Tallowood home internet plans run over the national wholesale network. There is no lock-in contract and all plans include unlimited data. Home 50 costs $75 per month, with a typical evening speed 48 Mbps. Home 100 costs $90 per month, with a typical evening speed 88 Mbps. Home 250 costs $105 per month, with a typical evening speed 205 Mbps; Home 250 is available only on fibre to the premises and cable connections. Typical evening speed is the average download speed our customers get between 7 pm and 11 pm, when the network is busiest. Upload speeds are up to 20 Mbps on Home 50 and Home 100, and up to 25 Mbps on Home 250. Your actual speed can be lower because of your connection type, your in-home wiring, Wi-Fi and the devices you use. Modem: the Tallowood Wi-Fi 6 modem costs $216 upfront, or $9 per month over 24 months. If you leave before the 24 months are up, the remaining modem payments are added to your final bill. You can bring your own compatible modem instead. A 4G backup stick that keeps you online during outages is available for $5 per month.

title: Moving home and new connections
text: New connections and moving home. New connections: if your address already has an active connection point, self-installed service is usually live within 1 to 3 business days. If a technician is needed, connection takes 5 to 15 business days, depending on wholesale network appointment availability. Moving home: tell us at least 10 business days before your move date, in the app or by phone, so we can book the new connection to start on your move-in day. Relocation is free if your new address can be self-installed, and $99 if a technician appointment is needed at the new address. If the new address can't get your current plan speed, we move you to the fastest available plan at that plan's price. If home internet isn't available at the new address at all, you can cancel without the 30-day notice period. Remember to take your modem with you and reconnect it at the new address. If you give less than 10 business days' notice, we will still try to help, but there may be a gap without service; we can send a 4G backup stick free for up to 14 days while you wait.

title: Service guarantee and outage credits
text: Service guarantee and outage credits. Home internet: if a fault you report isn't fixed within 2 business days, we credit $10 per day for each extra day until it is fixed. The credit is applied automatically and shows on your next bill as Outage credit. Total credits are capped at your monthly plan fee. If we miss a technician appointment without 24 hours' notice, you also get a $25 credit. Home internet credits don't apply to faults caused by your own equipment or wiring, scheduled maintenance we told you about at least 3 days ahead, or natural disasters and widespread emergencies. Mobile: there are no automatic credits for mobile network outages, or for coverage gaps in areas outside our coverage map. If a confirmed network outage affects your area for more than 24 hours, you can request a one-off $10 credit within 30 days of the outage, in the app or by phone. Emergency calls: even during an outage or with no Tallowood coverage, your phone may still reach 000 through another network. Check the outage map in the app for current faults and estimated fix times before calling us.

title: Cancellation terms, effective 1 March 2023
text: Cancelling a Tallowood service, effective 1 March 2023. Postpaid mobile and home internet services can be cancelled at any time, with no notice period. Your final bill is pro-rated to the day you cancel, and any plan fee paid in advance for days after cancellation is credited back. Porting your mobile number to another provider cancels your Tallowood service automatically on the day the port completes. Prepaid services can be closed at any time, but unused credit and recharge value are non-refundable on closure. Phone repayments: when you cancel a postpaid service, any remaining phone repayment balance becomes due in full on your final bill. Modem repayments: any remaining modem payments are added to your final bill. To cancel, call us or use the chat in the app; for security we will confirm by text to the account holder. Cancellation requests made in store are processed within 1 business day.

title: Cancellation terms, effective 1 August 2026
text: Cancelling a Tallowood service, effective 1 August 2026. This replaces the March 2023 version. Notice period: postpaid mobile and home internet services now require 30 days' notice. When you ask to cancel, your service stays active and billing continues until the end of the 30-day notice period, followed by a final bill. The notice period also applies when you port a postpaid mobile number to another provider; the service ends when the port completes, but you are charged until the 30 days are up. No notice is needed if you move to an address where we can't provide home internet, if you are on our financial hardship program, or if you cancel within the first 30 days of a new service. Prepaid services can be closed at any time. Any unused dollar credit, not including plan inclusions or banked data, is refundable on request within 60 days of closing, paid to an Australian bank account; the minimum refund is $5. Phone repayments are not affected by cancelling: you can keep paying the phone monthly on the original schedule, or pay it out at any time. Remaining modem payments are added to your final bill. To cancel, call us or use the chat in the app.

title: Bills, payments and overdue accounts
text: Bills and payments. Postpaid bills are issued monthly and are due 14 days after the bill date. You can pay by direct debit from a bank account, credit or debit card, BPAY, or in the Tallowood app. We don't charge card payment surcharges. Late payment: Tallowood does not charge late payment fees. However, if your bill is still unpaid 14 days after the due date, we suspend outgoing calls, texts and data; incoming calls and calls to 000 keep working. If the bill remains unpaid 42 days after the due date, the service may be cancelled and the debt referred to a collection agency. Payment arrangements: if you can't pay on time, contact us before the due date to set up a payment arrangement or extension, and we won't suspend your service while you stick to it. Failed payments: if a direct debit or card payment fails, a $7.50 dishonour fee applies to cover our bank processing costs, and we retry the payment 3 days later. Paper bills cost $2.20 each; email and app bills are free. Pensioners and concession card holders can ask us to waive the dishonour fee once a year.

title: Phone repayments
text: Buying a phone on repayments. You can buy a phone from Tallowood on interest-free repayments over 12, 24 or 36 months, added to your monthly bill. Repayments are separate from your plan. If you cancel or change your plan, or port your number away, you can keep paying the phone monthly on the original schedule; the remaining balance does not become due straight away. You can also pay out the remaining balance at any time, with no fee, in the app or by phone. Upgrading early: once you have made 12 monthly repayments, you can upgrade to a new phone before your term ends by trading in your current phone in working condition, and we waive the remaining repayments. The traded-in phone must power on, hold a charge, have no cracks on the screen and have any account lock removed. If you upgrade without trading in, you keep paying off the old phone as well. Missed repayments: if two repayments in a row are missed, the remaining balance becomes due in full. Device Cover for loss, theft and accidental damage costs $12 per month and can be added only within 30 days of buying the phone.

title: Contact hours and complaints
text: Contacting Tallowood. Phone support is open weekdays 7 am to 10 pm and weekends 8 am to 6 pm, Sydney time, and closed on Christmas Day. Live chat in the Tallowood app is available 24/7. Most Tallowood stores open 9 am to 5:30 pm on weekdays with late trading to 9 pm on Thursday, 9 am to 5 pm on Saturday and 10 am to 4 pm on Sunday; check the store finder for local hours. Complaints: you can complain by phone, chat, email or in store. We acknowledge every complaint within 1 business day and give you a reference number. We aim to resolve complaints within 10 business days, and urgent complaints, such as a total loss of service or financial hardship, within 2 business days. If we need longer, we will tell you why and give you a new date, which will be no more than 20 business days from when you complained. If you're unhappy with our answer, you can ask for a review by our Complaints Review Team. You can also contact the industry ombudsman at any time; it is free and independent, though it will usually ask you to give us a chance to fix the problem first.
